units.source_text: 匂亲王受苦更甚：自闻浮舟死耗，二三日间神志昏迷，似乎已经魂不附体。

en.t: Prince Niou suffered even more deeply: from the time he heard the news of Ukifune's death, he spent two or three days in a daze, as though his soul had already left his body.

units.source_text: 旁人都以为鬼怪作祟，十分惊慌。

en.t: Everyone around him thought some spirit was at work and became terribly alarmed.

units.source_text: 后来他的眼泪逐渐哭干，心情略微镇静下来，

en.t: Later, when his tears had gradually run dry and his heart had grown a little calmer,

units.source_text: 想起了浮舟生前模样，更增悲伤恋慕之情。

en.t: he remembered Ukifune as she had been in life, and his grief and longing only grew stronger.

units.source_text: 他对于外人，只说身患重病。

en.t: To outsiders, he merely said that he was gravely ill.

units.source_text: 但无端哭肿两眼，不便叫人看见，

en.t: But since his eyes were swollen from weeping for no apparent reason, it was awkward to let anyone see him,

units.source_text: 便巧妙地设法隐蔽，然而悲伤之色自然显露。

en.t: so he cleverly found ways to hide it, yet the look of sorrow naturally showed through.

units.source_text: 也有人说：“亲王为了何事而如此伤心？

en.t: Some people also said, "What could have made the prince so heartbroken?

units.source_text: 看他忧愁得性命垂危呢！”

en.t: He looks so grief-stricken that his very life seems in danger!"

units.source_text: 薰大将详悉匂亲王忧伤之状，想道：“果然不出我之所料，

en.t: General Kaoru learned in detail how deeply Prince Niou was grieving and thought, "It is just as I expected.

units.source_text: 他和浮舟的关系不仅是寻常通信而已。

en.t: His relationship with Ukifune was not merely an ordinary exchange of letters.

units.source_text: 浮舟这个人，只要被他一见，定然牵惹他的神魂。

en.t: Once he had seen someone like Ukifune, she was certain to capture his heart and soul.

units.source_text: 如果她生存在世，定会做出比过去更加使我难堪的事来。”

en.t: If she had remained alive in this world, she would surely have done things that embarrassed me even more than before."

units.source_text: 如此一想，他对浮舟的悼念之情稍稍消减了。

en.t: Thinking this, his mourning for Ukifune lessened a little.
